leadText:
Zisu (Japanese: ペリーラ Perilla) is the captain of the Galaxy Team's Security Corps. 

She bears a striking resemblance to Flint and Buck, but the relationship between them, if any, is unknown.
plainText:
Zisu (Japanese: ペリーラ Perilla) is the captain of the Galaxy Team's Security Corps. 

She bears a striking resemblance to Flint and Buck, but the relationship between them, if any, is unknown.

==In the core series games==
For most of the game, Zisu can be found at the training grounds in Jubilife Village. She offers the various services:
Tutoring new moves to a Pokémon, in exchange for money
As the player increases their rank, more moves will be available to choose from
Help a Pokémon master a move, in exchange for a Seed of Mastery
Exchanging Grit items, at the following rates
1 Grit Gravel for 10 Grit Dusts
1 Grit Pebble for 10 Grit Gravels
1 Grit Rock for 10 Grit Pebbles

Zisu's services become temporarily inaccessible from Mission 13: "Disaster Looming" to Mission 17: "Atop Mount Coronet" due to the player's exile from Jubilife Village.

She can sometimes be found at Dagero's photography studio in Jubilife Village, and when talked to, she will ask to take a picture with the player.

===Pokémon===
By speaking to Ingo at the training grounds, the player can initiate battles against Zisu. 

====Regular team====
 
 
 
 
 
 
====Path of Tenacity====
The Path of Tenacity battles are available in version 1.1.0 after completing Request 102: "Daybreak".

==In the TCG==
 
 
Zisu was introduced as a in the Pokémon Trading Card Game during the English Sword & Shield Series (the Japanese Sword & Shield Era). It was first released in the expansion before debuting in English in the expansion, with a regular print, a and a Rainbow Rare print, all with artwork by KirisAki. This card allows the player to draw cards until they have one more than their opponent.
 
==Trivia==
Zisu's hair resembles the ears of a .
Zisu's final team in the Path of Tenacity uses the same Pokémon as Flint's team in and his initial team in .
Upon defeating Zisu's fourth Path of Tenacity team, she will reveal that Cyllene was one of the best swordswomen in all of Hoenn.
